zh.title: 華航首度榮獲SGS 2026 DT Awards隱私暨個資管理卓越獎
zh.summary: 華航表示首度榮獲SGS 2026 DT Awards隱私暨個資管理卓越獎
body: 中華航空股份有限公司表示，首度榮獲SGS 2026 DT Awards「隱私暨個資管理卓越獎」。華航稱，本屆有23家企業角逐該獎項，僅2家獲獎，華航是唯一獲獎的航空公司。
華航表示，公司將資安與個人資料保護納入公司治理，建置風險管理機制，並取得ISO 27001資訊安全管理系統及ISO 27701隱私資訊管理系統國際驗證。相關規範落實於旅客訂位、購票、報到及空中服務等流程。
華航另表示，已導入數位化個資管理系統，整合個資盤點、隱私衝擊評估及風險追蹤等功能。

en.title: China Airlines wins privacy and personal-data management award at 2026 SGS DT Awards
en.summary: China Airlines says it won the 2026 SGS DT Awards' privacy and personal-data management award.
body: China Airlines said it won the Privacy and Personal Data Management Excellence Award at the 2026 SGS DT Awards for the first time. The airline said 23 companies competed for the award and two received it; China Airlines was the only airline among the winners.

The company said it incorporates information security and personal-data protection into its corporate governance, has established a risk-management framework, and has obtained international certifications for ISO 27001 information security management and ISO 27701 privacy information management. It said related requirements are applied to passenger reservations, ticket purchases, check-in and in-flight services.
China Airlines also said it introduced a digital personal-data management system integrating personal-data inventories, privacy impact assessments and risk tracking.
